description: This file defines an interface named FileRemove, which declares methods for removing files and multiple files within the CMS content module of the application.

classes.name: FileRemove
classes.description: An interface for removing content files in the CMS module.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file identified by filename for a given merchant store and content type.

methods.description: Removes all files associated with a given merchant store.
